question: Why was Ezra ashamed to ask the king for soldiers to protect them?
options: He had told the king God's hand is on those who look to him
The king had no soldiers to give
The soldiers were needed in Egypt
The people wanted to travel alone
explanation: Ezra had told the king, "The gracious hand of our God is on everyone who looks to him," so he was ashamed to ask for soldiers and horsemen.
